unverified_summary: Nothing on this page is publisher confirmed, and that is the finding rather than a gap in the work. The experience description carries no code list, the community that publishes the game has no shout, and the dedicated codes channel that once existed in the official Discord was removed, so no tier zero or tier one source states any string. BESTBRAINROTEVER is carried by two outlets and the community wiki and is listed as Unverified for that reason. Whether codes are case sensitive is genuinely contested between outlets. BRUNOISBETTER and BLUESAMMY67 come from a single outlet with no wiki record. Exact drop and burn out dates for most codes are not recorded anywhere reliable, because stock caps kill these codes rather than calendar expiry, so per code end dates are left empty rather than invented.

disagreements.item: Whether the game has codes at all
disagreements.source_a: PCGamesN states no code has ever released and that the removal of the Discord codes channel means one may never arrive
disagreements.source_b: The community wiki records the redemption feature shipping in the Christmas update and lists more than twenty codes issued since
disagreements.confirmed: Codes exist. That page is describing a state the game left behind, and its redemption instructions point at a menu the code field no longer lives in.

disagreements.source_a: GamesRadar states codes are not case sensitive and you do not have to use capitals
disagreements.source_b: Dexerto and several trackers state the field enforces exact case and that a lower case attempt is rejected
disagreements.confirmed: Not settled. Every code the developer has issued is upper case, so typing the string exactly as recorded works either way. This page records every row as case sensitive because that assumption never costs you a redemption.

disagreements.item: The exact string for the older La Vacca Saturno Saturnita code
disagreements.confirmed: Neither. The community wiki has no record of the string in any case, so it is listed here in upper case and flagged.

disagreements.source_a: GamesRadar and Dexerto both list it as active, and one recorded a fresh recheck
disagreements.source_b: PCGamesN and Pocket Tactics both state there are no active codes
disagreements.confirmed: Not confirmable without redeeming it. It is listed as Unverified rather than Active, and the row explains why.

disagreements.source_a: Beebom lists both in its expired set
disagreements.source_b: The community wiki and GamesRadar, which between them carry every other code on this page, have no record of either
disagreements.confirmed: No corroboration. Both are archived as expired so the strings are searchable, with the gap in sourcing stated on the row.

fakes.claim: Aggregator pages listing twenty or more codes as currently working, including WSUMMERUPD1, JOHNPORKDAPIGGY and FREEOCTO555
fakes.why_wrong: Those strings are on the community wiki's unavailable list and in GamesRadar's expired list. The page has reprinted the archive under an active heading, which is why readers report that nothing on it redeems.
fakes.origin: rblxguide.com and several other automatically generated code trackers

fakes.claim: EASTER2026, TACOTUESDAY and THANKSFOR1B, presented with drop dates
fakes.why_wrong: The dates attached to them fall before the redemption feature existed, and one falls before the experience was published on Roblox at all. No wiki entry and no outlet record either string.
fakes.origin: rblxguide.com, which attaches invented timestamps to invented strings

fakes.claim: CANDY as a standalone code rewarding a Strawberry Elephant
fakes.why_wrong: It is a truncation of CANDY24SAMMY, a riddle code with a single redemption that was claimed once. The shortened string has never been valid.
fakes.origin: Copy and paste drift between aggregator sites

fakes.claim: Codes taken from Steal The Brainrot Base, the Fortnite island Stealing Brainrots, or browser games called Steal Brainrot Online
fakes.why_wrong: Those are separate products by separate publishers. Their strings are rejected by place ID 109983668079237 and by every other place in the same universe.
fakes.origin: Clone titles ranking for the same search term, plus video thumbnails that do not name which game they are showing

fakes.claim: Codes that grant free Robux, cash, or a Secret brainrot straight into your inventory
fakes.why_wrong: The redemption system spawns a brainrot on the red carpet and you still have to buy it with in game cash. No code on record has ever paid Robux or deposited anything into an inventory.
fakes.origin: Video titles and comment spam, often attached to a link that harvests account credentials

changes.what: Code redemption added to the game, with the Festive 67 plush code as the first string it accepted
Redemption moved out of the shop menu to a dedicated Codes button on the left of the screen, and a batch of summer update codes dropped
Code drops resumed after a pause caused by a group harvesting codes with automated tooling, and L2EXPLOITERS was issued
An outlet recheck reported BESTBRAINROTEVER still live, which is the freshest external check this page could find
Page published with the full archive, the corrected redemption path, and the case sensitivity conflict recorded

next_change.pattern: Codes drop live during Admin Abuse, which runs after the Saturday update at around 3pm Eastern and on Taco Tuesday at 6pm Eastern. Sammy posts them in the running server and in the community server, sometimes as riddles rather than plain strings. Stock is capped rather than dated, so a drop with a low cap can be gone within minutes and a wide one lasts weeks.
